name: Hoshina Mizuho
source:
Hozumi's twin brother, the student council president. He’s kind to everyone, very popular with the girls and always accepts their cakes and cookies, even though he claims not liking sweets.

[From [url=https://maidenkingdom.wordpress.com/2014/06/22/otoge-review-watashi-no-real-wa-juujitsu-shisugiteiru/]Maiden Kingdom[/url]]
